lock is pin-only (no hashes) + 8 deps below security floors in sandbox; ENV-005 hermetic container closes both (--strict already certifies it).

.env.example ships a concrete bcrypt DASHBOARD_ADMIN_PASSWORD_HASH (one-way, non-blocking); placeholder cleaner. git-history not deep-scanned (--no-git).
